text: Rae (People Ops): Idea: a 2-hour pop-up "Micro Kudos Photo Booth" where folks get a quick Polaroid + a tiny spot-award sticker when a peer submits kudos at the kiosk. Low-cost, tactile, and fun. Thoughts? :camera_flash: Devin (Events): sounds delightful. Where would you put it and how many prints? Rae (People Ops): thinking lobby near kitchen, Thu July 8, 12-2. We can do ~150 prints (instant film) and 150 stickers. Tom (Facilities): lobby good. I'll block space and power. watch for fire code if we put a tripod by the stairwell. Clara (Finance): film is expensive — Instax approx $0.80-1.20/print. camera rental? any vendor? Rae (People Ops): vendor quote: $1.10/print + $60 one-day kit rental. estimate ~$225 incl extras. use GL 4102. Clara (Finance): fine, under petty spend threshold; just upload receipt; if over $500 need approval. hr-bot: Reminder: record non-cash awards via /recognize so we capture them for payroll reporting. Rae (People Ops): volunteers to staff kiosk and to operate camera? Devin (Events): I can run 12-1, Rae you do 1-2? Rae (People Ops): yes. need one more volunteer 12-1 slot. Tom (Facilities): I can cover 12-1 if needed. also will bring a small table and sign. Devin (Events): logistics: 1) kiosk tablet with short nomination form + QR 2) table, Polaroid camera, film stack, sticker sheet 3) checklist for name + manager 4) limit 1 print per person. Rae (People Ops): policy note: prints < $10 are non-taxable but we must track recipients. we'll use a quick form that auto-posts to recognition portal with tag #micro-kudos-booth. Clara (Finance): confirm GL 4102 and that runtime budget covers film. Rae (People Ops): confirmed. Clara (Finance): also note if managers want to award extra monetary micro-grant, that needs separate payroll workflow. Rae (People Ops): agreed — keep it sticker/print only. Devin (Events): I'll make signage and a tiny script volunteers read: "Take a photo, write a 1-line shoutout on the tablet, get your instant print + sticker. One per person please." hr-bot: Note: entries tagged #micro-kudos-booth will be included in the monthly recognition export. Rae (People Ops): action items: Devin — signage + signup; Tom — reserve table/power; Clara — confirm petty spend path; I'll order film and make the recognition form. Devin (Events): posting signup in #people-ops now. Rae (People Ops): thanks team! excited for the silly Polaroids. :sparkles:
